questions.why: The outline lacks details on user interface design, stakeholder consultation, and ethical governance frameworks (fairness, diversity, and explainability) required to complete the assessment.

items.text: Has the department established a clear definition and measurement framework for fairness in the context of AI-driven entity extraction from internal communications?
options: Yes, both are defined and documented
A definition is established, but measurement methods are still being developed
No, fairness frameworks have not yet been defined for this use case

items.text: Have the primary users (departmental staff and policy researchers) and IT/data governance teams been consulted regarding the design and deployment of the knowledge graph?
options: Yes, all identified stakeholder groups have been consulted
Some stakeholders have been consulted (e.g., IT/data governance), but not end-users
No consultation has taken place yet

items.text: Will the system's interface disclose when relationships are AI-generated, provide explanations for those links, and offer a non-AI search alternative?
options: Yes, the interface will support disclosures, explanations, and non-AI alternatives
It will support disclosures and explanations, but no non-AI alternative is planned
No interface features for disclosure or explanation have been defined yet

gaps.reason: The outline does not state if a definition of fairness has been established for the extraction of entities and relationships from internal documents.
The outline does not specify any qualitative or quantitative metrics to measure or monitor the fairness of the AI's extractions.
The outline does not confirm whether the identified stakeholders (staff, researchers, IT/data governance, leadership) have been consulted.
The outline does not mention whether any information about this internal knowledge graph will be made publicly available.
The outline does not detail the user interface, whether users will be notified of AI-generated outputs, or if non-AI alternatives are provided.
The outline does not state whether the system will provide explanations of the factors leading to the AI-extracted relationships.
The outline does not provide information on the composition of the project team or how diversity has been incorporated into the lifecycle.
